mapper.select: SELECT u.nickname AS reportNickname, pr.content AS reason, pr.report_date as reportDate FROM post_report pr JOIN user u ON pr.report_user_id = u.user_id WHERE pr.post_id = #{postId}
SELECT u.nickname AS reportNickname, cr.content AS reason, cr.report_date AS reportDate FROM comment_report cr JOIN user u ON cr.report_user_id = u.user_id WHERE cr.comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT u.nickname AS reportNickname, rp.content AS reason, rp.report_date AS reportDate FROM review_report rp JOIN user u ON rp.report_user_id = u.user_id WHERE rp.review_id = #{reviewId}
